endpoints.summary: Roll the fleet (or a subset) to a target revision
endpoints.description: Pins every registered (or named) node to a target git revision: enumerates the eligible nodes, classifies each (online + protocol-compatible + not-revoked → dispatch; otherwise skip with a reason), dispatches a privileged provisioning op to each eligible node, and records a durable rollout with the per-node ledger. target_revision defaults to the control plane's current commit (pass "@cp" to say so explicitly) and is resolved+preflighted ONCE up front, so the whole fleet pins to a single exact commit and an unpushed target fails the roll before any node is touched. Honours X-Dry-Run. Owner-gated.

endpoints.summary: Onboard a raw SSH host into the fleet (one-shot, durable)
endpoints.description: Drives a raw SSH-reachable host from bare OS to a paired, ONLINE, auto-starting fleet agent in one durable, server-owned op (SSH first-touch → push bootstrap script → remote bootstrap → verify online). Honours X-Dry-Run. Owner-gated.
